title: Website optimisation
seoTitle: Website Optimisation: Speed, UX & Conversion | EFIops
metaDescription: Improve an existing website's performance, usability and enquiry journey. EFIops identifies practical changes and checks their impact against a baseline.
h1: Make the website you have work harder.
lead: The useful change isn’t always a rebuild. Find the slow page, the awkward menu, the unclear offer or the form that asks too much—and improve the part standing between a visit and a useful enquiry.

sections.heading: A useful improvement may be smaller than a rebuild.
paragraphs: Visitors may struggle to read the page on mobile, understand the offer, find the contact button or finish the form. The site may load more slowly than it should.
We look for the specific problem before deciding whether to improve the existing site or recommend a larger change.

sections.heading: Find the friction. Improve the experience.
items: Performance work. Investigate heavy assets, unnecessary scripts and other causes of slow loading or interaction.
Mobile usability. Improve readability, navigation, controls and forms on smaller screens.
Conversion paths. Review the steps between arriving, understanding the offer and making an enquiry.
Content clarity. Improve headings, service explanations and calls to action.
Measurement. Establish a baseline and choose meaningful checks for the change.

sections.heading: Measure the starting point, then improve it.
paragraphs: We review the current experience and any available analytics, agree the priority changes and implement them in a reviewable version. Technical checks show whether performance and usability have improved.
When traffic and tracking support it, enquiries or other conversions can be compared over a suitable period. Small samples and changes in traffic quality are considered when interpreting the result.

faqs.question: Do we need a new website?
faqs.answer: Not always. The review should establish whether focused improvements are practical or whether the current platform is limiting the work.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee more enquiries?
faqs.answer: No. We can improve the experience and measure available outcomes, but traffic quality, the offer and customer demand also affect enquiries.

faqs.question: Is website optimisation the same as SEO?
faqs.answer: They overlap, but this service focuses on the visitor's experience and the site's performance. SEO work also considers search discovery, page intent and content relevance.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing platform?
faqs.answer: We first check access, the platform and any limitations. The scope depends on what can be changed safely and effectively.

cta.label: Discuss website improvements
cta.heading: Where does your website make things harder?
cta.text: Share the URL and the part of the experience you want to improve.

primaryIntent: website optimisation services; website speed and conversion improvements.
summary: Improve speed, clarity and the journey from a visit to a useful enquiry.

useCases.title: Can I find the next step with one hand?
useCases.body: Review the real navigation, text and controls on small screens. Put the useful action where people can find it.

useCases.title: Which question is making people stop?
useCases.body: Review required fields, error states and confirmation. Check the journey end to end rather than treating a button click as a lead.

useCases.title: What is the browser waiting for?
useCases.body: Measure the baseline, inspect assets and scripts, then check changes under the same conditions. Keep technical results separate from sales outcomes.
